**Corvinus University of Budapest**

Corvinus University of Budapest is Hungary’s leading university in the field of economic and social sciences. Corvinus University is located just a few minutes’ walk from the central downtown Budapest. It is acknowledged to be the most prominent centre for education and research in business, financial management, management and organization, marketing, information management, business ethics, environmental management and management practice in Hungary.

The excellent quality of education offered by Corvinus is acknowledged worldwide and is reflected by its diverse international partners as well as in its memberships in select organizations. For international students studying in Corvinus’ English language bachelor and master programs and for the large number of incoming international exchange students, Corvinus offers a wide range of courses in English and German (over 140 different subjects each semester) involving most of the Departments and covering all the fields of specialization. With over 400 international students coming from close to 50 countries each semester, Corvinus offers its students the added value of a truly international atmosphere. In addition to offering educational programs at bachelor, master and doctoral levels, Corvinus University is also involved in a wide range of domestic and international studies and research projects.
